instruction: In invoice.py, introduce a dataclass Line with fields unit_price: float, quantity: int, discount_pct: float (in that order), and change line_total(unit_price, quantity, discount_pct) to line_total(line) taking one Line. invoice_total now receives a list of Line objects. describe keeps its signature describe(unit_price, quantity, discount_pct) and builds a Line to call line_total. Update tests/test_invoice.py to construct Line objects. Change nothing else.
notes: rope has introduce_parameter (a single parameter), not a parameter object.
